comparison.objective: Fit terminal covers and store battery packs upright without any unprotected tray entry; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cover fitting and protected multi-object placement versus recessed tool alignment, collar adjustment, locking torque, and repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Each covered pack stored upright, with unsafe entry causing zero, versus two safe stops and post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: Different physical mechanism and success state despite both having permanent unsafe-failure conditions. No spec versions or numeric fit/upright tolerances were supplied.
